lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of approximately 25-30 high-luminance circular spots is visible on the central flank, organized into roughly five distinct vertical columns and six horizontal rows posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating an orthogonal lattice pattern on the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two horizontal linear features are visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with lighter pixels above and shadow-weighted pixels below the ridge lines.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-contrast, sparse clusters of high-luminance pixels are visible within the blurred silhouette of the first dorsal fin, though resolution is degraded by water turbidity.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density population of smaller, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the leading edge and proximal base.
